scope: Five exact original provider findings only. Available frameworks, limited data/code and access-limited repository observations are preserved. No broad SysCap/API/backend exclusions.

LiveCaptions.reason: No complete distributable real-time caption provider in verified OpenHarmony/SIG sources; sample model objects/dependencies/licensing and streaming provider are incomplete.

SecurityGuardModels.reason: Official 7.0 and master production modelcfg are empty; no complete default risk model in inspected sources.

AudioVividMetaBuilder.reason: Official implementation supplies wrapper/abstract ABI/optional dlopen; complete MetaBuilder plugin absent from inspected build targets and Media SIG component list.

reopen: Supply a complete lawful provider/data/model/product identity, integrate it and restore that exact finding to runtime acceptance.
